amendment_note: Confirmatory multi-corpus test of the v1.9 Parseval-normalized geometric Fourier moment. Frozen after the one-corpus pilot but before any stride-transformed TinyStories, WikiText-2, or CodeParrot learning curve or spectrum was computed.

intervention.transform: split each fixed byte stream into s equal contiguous lanes and emit the transpose round-robin
invariants: approximately the same pair-spectrum level masses and degree
intervention.intended_change: natural dependency support moves from approximately (1,2) to (s,2s)

spectrum.position_sampling: uniform corpus-wide time indices with every interleaved lane represented in both cross-fit folds
comparators: mean degree conditioned on nonconstant energy

difficulty.primary: dataset-stride median final held-out CE divided by initial held-out CE; higher is harder
difficulty.secondary: dataset-stride median normalized held-out curve area over log1p token time
difficulty.reason: the v1.9 curves showed that area mixes acquisition speed with the final finite-budget plateau

confirmatory_test.statistic: mean of the four within-dataset Spearman correlations between G_total and primary difficulty
confirmatory_test.null: independently permute the four difficulty labels within each dataset
confirmatory_test.support_rule: SUPPORTED if blocked rho>=0.70, exact two-sided p<0.05, stride-8 primary difficulty exceeds stride-1 in at least 3 of 4 datasets, and the seed-specific blocked rho is positive for all three seeds
confirmatory_test.refute_rule: REFUTED if blocked rho<=0 or stride-8 primary difficulty fails to exceed stride-1 in at least 3 of 4 datasets

scope: confirmation of a causal locality effect on these four fixed real byte corpora and this learner; not a universal cross-domain law
